$comment: PROJECT settings — checked in, shared by everyone (and by every agent-pipeline worktree).
Personal permission grants belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which is gitignored.
The two config blocks below MUST live here rather than in the local file: the pipeline runs
each agent in a `git worktree` checkout, and a gitignored file does not exist in a fresh
worktree — so a worktree would silently lose its symlinks and its MCP servers.
permissions.allow here is deliberately read-only and narrow. Anything that mutates state, and
anything that can execute arbitrary code (interpreters, `docker exec`, `gh api` wildcards), is
left out on purpose: this file pre-approves those actions for ANY checkout of the repo.
enabledPlugins names the plugin, extraKnownMarketplaces names where it comes from. Both are
needed here for the same worktree reason: a fresh checkout that knows the plugin but not its
marketplace cannot resolve it, so the plugin silently does not load.
Note that `caveman` installs a SessionStart hook, so enabling it HERE turns the compressed
response style on for every agent working in this checkout, not just for one person.
